rulings.reason: BOOT ALLOCATION #1 OF 5: freeze the limited trial candidate (new authority snapshot naming the candidate head) and re-run the accepted FS/Search live acceptance ON that frozen tree, so M-01/M-02/M-06/M-07 stop being NEEDS_REVALIDATION. ONE start. Starts 2 and 3 are the BL-17/BL-18 live halves; 4-5 are reserved for retries of THIS allocation's failure class and may not be used for a new acceptance face.
conditions: freeze first: publish a new immutable authority snapshot naming the candidate head as baseline, then move the pointer with scripts/switch-authority.mjs; no hand-edited pointer
boot at the exact tree the snapshot names as baseline; the run record must carry that same 40-hex sha and the authority re-stamped to the live generation with authorityObserved preserved
port family 3180 (never :3080), DSH_HOME under tests/homes/<world> inside the workspace, per-run grant.json, archive-before-start, managed background job (never nohup &)
one start: a failed row is reported with its transcript, never retried into a pass and never dropped; an aborted start still counts as spent
no scope creep: Bash/PTY and Web live runs are later allocations

note: The 5-start grant is independent of the 2026-11-05 10-start P2-04 grant; the two must never be summed. Unspent starts expire with this allocation and do not roll over.
remainingAfterThisLane: starts 2-5 of the 2026-11-06 grant (BL-17, BL-18, two retries)
